IDH1 or IDH2 mutation status confirmed by TruSight(TM) Oncology 500 performed in LP, NCI or prior documentation of IDH1 or IDH2 mutation status

candidate_evidence.quote: [EXPERIMENTAL] 2: Estimated RP2D of zotiraciclib given in 28 day cycles (interventions: Drug: Zotiraciclib)
This is a phase I/II study to evaluate the safety and efficacy of zotiraciclib as a single agent in recurrent IDH-mutant gliomas.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Participants must have recurrent disease, proven histologically or by imaging studies

role_evidence.quote: This is a phase I/II study to evaluate the safety and efficacy of zotiraciclib as a single agent in recurrent IDH-mutant gliomas.

agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: Zotiraciclib is a multi-kinase inhibitor that has been shown to have anti-glioma effects through transcriptional suppression, mitochondrial dysfunction, and adenosine 5'-triphosphate (ATP) reduction in glioblastoma in our preclinical studies

source_quote.quote: IDH1 or IDH2 mutation status confirmed by TruSight(TM) Oncology 500 performed in LP, NCI or prior documentation of IDH1 or IDH2 mutation status

coder_notes: Enrols only IDH1/2-mutant diffuse glioma (WHO grades 2-4); glioblastoma is not named in conditions, title, inclusion criteria or arm labels, and IDH-mutant grade 4 astrocytoma is not glioblastoma under CNS5, so not_glioblastoma. IDH mutation is an entry requirement; zotiraciclib (multi-kinase/CDK inhibitor) does not target IDH, though the record cites a preclinical 'selective vulnerability' of IDH-mutant gliomas; coded not candidate-matched. Surgical cohort 3 receives one dose before biopsy/resection, but no tumour drug-level or pharmacodynamic measurement is stated, so tumour PK and target engagement coded no. Arms are all experimental single-agent dose cohorts with no control. Age range includes 15-17 year olds.
